issuer.summary: Curve DAO is the governance organization associated with scrvUSD and its underlying. The issuer assessment is shared with crvUSD; Yearn’s code contribution is not a separate promise to redeem or compensate holders.
issuer.summary_source: RiskAnalyst scrvUSD assessment, October 17; tidresearch draft issuer section; riskAnalyst@8ee3dc4.
facts: Curve DAO is shared with the underlying crvUSD. Wrapping the asset does not create issuer diversification.
Yearn supplies vault implementation code; it is not a separate issuer guarantee.
